authority.environment: Codex delegated agent in the shared typst-crystalline worktree

vanilla.identity_rule: commit, tree, build recipe and binary SHA-256 are authoritative; the version string is only a sentinel

historical_snapshot.identity_rule: the verifier must freeze the complete commit identity and isolated rebuild receipt before delta attribution; this candidate contract does not infer the missing suffix

unit.definition: one bilateral cell identified by (probe_id, profile)
unit.symmetry_rule: the same probe source, inputs, environment policy, timeout and profile feature set must be applied to both products

included_public_effects: public CLI exit status, output meaning and diagnostics where the CLI is the specified surface
excluded_mechanics: exact rendered bytes without a declared semantic or morphological witness
observable_boundary.mechanics_exception: exact diagnostic text or other mechanics may be compared only when that text or mechanics is itself the public observable named by the probe
observable_boundary.measurement_before_classification: each class must be derived from recorded bilateral observations; a class must not be preassigned from a path name or historical P1353 result
observable_boundary.inference_rule: every inferred attribution must be marked as inferred, name its measured premises and state what evidence would refute it

normalized_side_observation.rule: VALUE and DIAGNOSTIC require complete=true and a canonical public observable; every other state is UNKNOWN

definitions.MATCH_VALUE: both complete observations are VALUE and their canonical semantic or morphological observables are equal
definitions.MATCH_DIAGNOSTIC: both complete observations are DIAGNOSTIC and their canonical public diagnostic observables are equal
definitions.VANILLA_ONLY: vanilla is a complete VALUE and crystalline is a complete DIAGNOSTIC that proves the probed binding or accepted construction is unavailable
definitions.CRYSTALLINE_ONLY: crystalline is a complete VALUE and vanilla is a complete DIAGNOSTIC that proves the probed binding or accepted construction is unavailable
definitions.DIFFERENT_VALUE: both complete observations are VALUE but their canonical semantic or morphological observables differ
definitions.DIFFERENT_DIAGNOSTIC: all remaining complete bilateral disagreements, including unequal diagnostics and VALUE-versus-DIAGNOSTIC cases not proven to be binding or construction absence
definitions.UNKNOWN: at least one side is incomplete, identity-ambiguous, unsupported by the parser or observer, timed out, source-missing, environment-invalid, or otherwise cannot support a language-level comparison

classes.exclusivity: exactly one class is emitted per cell
classes.priority_rule: UNKNOWN dominates all other classes; ONLY classes require an explicit absence witness and are never inferred merely from a nonzero exit code

requirements: reason_code must be nonempty and from the frozen allowlist
the opaque fixture must identify the deliberately unavailable fact
production-corpus Unknown never counts as preserved, matched or rejected
zero unexplained production-corpus Unknown is required for P1356 closure
unknown_policy.opaque_fixture_rule: Unknown is the required success only for a fixture explicitly designated opaque before runner implementation

inventory_invariants: the catalog is the set union of discoveries from both products, explicit seeds, all 4718 P1353 catalog routes, and every new public surface named by the frozen P1356 step
the union is deduplicated by canonical public path without erasing aliases that are independently public bindings
all catalog entries are scheduled symmetrically in all four profiles
formats registered outside typst-library and bindings introduced through prelude_path are included
format, format.pdf/pdf, format.html/html, format.svg/svg, format.png/png, and format.bundle/asset are explicit required routes
a binding proven absent on one side is a bilateral difference; an extractor unable to observe it yields UNKNOWN
public kind is observable: function and module are not interchangeable
raw catalogs remain external to Git; committed evidence contains their hashes, counts, generation commands and the complete non-MATCH path list
matrix_invariants: every catalog probe has exactly one cell for every profile
both sides of a cell use identical profile features and declared inputs
every side records binary identity, exit code, exact stdout/stderr SHA-256, completeness and reason
classification uses language observables and does not grant or remove parity credit from internal refactors
rendered-byte differences are ignored unless a probe declares a semantic or morphological witness derived from the public output
the path-level summary is derived from cells and lists every path with at least one non-MATCH cell
counts are derived from the canonical cell array and must sum to the exact cell count
historical P1353 classes are inputs to delta attribution only and never expected results for the new matrix
required_sentinel_families: format binding types, format scopes and pdf/html/svg/png/asset aliases
format set rules, document-versus-CLI precedence and rejection inside containers
pdf named arguments, warnings and incompatibilities
luma omitted lightness, hint and integer alpha 0 through 255
columns separator in LTR, RTL, empty-column and custom-content cases
lone tagged block vertical expansion with a multiple-child control
CJK pairs ｟｠, 〘〙 and 〝〟 by observable position and break behavior
one HTML author meta element per author
sys.version equal to version(0, 15, 1) without inferring why

classes.RETAINED_GAP: the crystalline path disagrees with both the historical snapshot and vanilla in the relevant observable, while the historical snapshot and vanilla preserve the relevant target behavior
classes.RESOLVED_BY_PRODUCT: the path disagreed in the frozen historical measurement but current crystalline matches vanilla and the resolution cannot be attributed solely to target drift
classes.TARGET_DRIFT: the current crystalline observation is unchanged relative to the historical snapshot while the snapshot and vanilla differ, and the new disagreement is therefore produced only by the target change
classes.NEW_CRYSTALLINE_GAP: the new target exposes or changes a public language surface that current crystalline does not match, with complete observations excluding harness insufficiency
classes.HARNESS_GAP: the declared public observable exists but the comparator cannot represent it soundly
classes.UNKNOWN: identity, environment or observation is insufficient for attribution

requirements: catalog entries and exits are reported separately from the intersection
each attribution records measured premises, whether the conclusion is inferred, and a refuting observation
raw totals from P1353 and P1356 are not directly compared without the catalog delta

canonicalization.serialization: compact JSON with object keys sorted lexicographically and no insignificant whitespace
canonicalization.side_payload: exit code, exact stdout/stderr SHA-256, canonical observable SHA-256, completeness and reason_code
canonicalization.p1353_compatibility: preserves the P1353 compact-array ordering and exact-stream hash receipts while adding an explicit language-observable hash

determinism.requirement: all repetitions and both execution orders yield byte-identical canonical semantic payloads and identical aggregate counts
determinism.order_recanonicalization: physical execution order must never be reused as serialization order
determinism.nondeterminism_result: UNKNOWN with OBSERVER_INCOMPLETE unless the cause invalidates the whole run, in which case the run is invalid and cannot be sealed

minimum_mutants.mutation: replace new vanilla commit 586e1bd43fae6c9a973218163d3165c53ab8d16d with old pin a51e02804
minimum_mutants.witness: baseline commit or tree identity mismatch

minimum_mutants.mutation: accept the P1353 vanilla binary SHA-256 as the new vanilla binary
serialize physical reverse-run result order without recanonicalizing
minimum_mutants.witness: canonical payload differs by execution order

minimum_mutants.mutation: run different feature sets on vanilla and crystalline for the same profile
omit a binding introduced by prelude_path from inventory union
minimum_mutants.witness: required alias is absent from the scheduled catalog

minimum_mutants.mutation: classify html or pdf as module when the frozen new vanilla exposes it as function
convert timeout, parser unsupported or source missing to a MATCH class
minimum_mutants.witness: incomplete side observation was promoted from Unknown

minimum_mutants.mutation: classify a rendered-byte difference as a language difference without a semantic or morphological witness

oracle_expectations.negative_mutants: every valid minimum mutant must classify Violated with a public witness
oracle_expectations.opaque_fixtures: deliberately opaque fixtures must classify Unknown with the predeclared reason_code

candidate_contract: this artifact is frozen by SHA-256 before runner implementation
the manifest records this contract hash, all frozen input hashes, role capabilities and baseline identities
oracles, mutants and opaque fixtures are authored without access to the runner candidate
harness_seal: all valid positive fixtures are Preserved
all valid negative mutants are Violated with witnesses
all and only predeclared opaque fixtures are Unknown
canonical and reverse execution orders and both repetitions are canonically identical
a verifier without write authority over protected artifacts approves the receipts
p1356_closure: the new inventory and bilateral matrix cover every scheduled cell in all four profiles
there are zero unexplained production-corpus Unknown cells
all non-MATCH routes are listed completely
delta attribution is complete path-by-path on the frozen catalog
each decision-bearing count records code state, UTC, commands and input and binary hashes
no L1 through L4 file changed in P1356
final project gates and independent verification required by typst-passo-1356 pass
invalidators: contract, manifest, baseline, corpus, oracle or mutant hash changes after sealing
a role receives capability outside its declared allowlist
candidate implementation leaks to contract or oracle authors before freeze
Unknown is implicitly treated as success
the verifier edits an artifact it verifies
a receipt omits enough command, version or input identity to reproduce the claim

calibration_budget.stop_rule: two consecutive revisions without new discriminatory power require redesign and prohibit sealing; the budget never authorizes weakening Unknown or the observable boundary
